Description/Rules

Cornucopians - Thank you for participating in this giveaway! The purpose of this campaign is to not only grow our community, but to spread the word of our newly launched “bubble” concept. This is where you come in! By participating in this giveaway, you will be helping us by organically sharing, retweeting, and posting the content we have provided. Growing our community is critical to the success of our game and we want to reward you for being a part of it. (See giveaways below) Please note that we will not tolerate any kind of foul play. This is setup to be cheat proof, but If we see anything suspicious going on, you will immediately be removed from the server. I know you guys would never cheat anyways… right?!

How does it work?

After logging in, you will be presented with a list of actionable items that are to be executed on a variety of social platforms. For every “action” you complete, you earn 1 entry. For each entry you earn, you have a better chance of having your name drawn at the end of the challenge. If you don't feel comfortable completing a social challenge, no worries! Just move on to the next task. Once our campaign has completed, our team will schedule the 2nd AMA where we will go into greater detail about the “bubble” concept and how it will be the centerpoint of Cornucopias. We will then randomly draw our winners and announce them live.

 If you are running into anti-spam issues, please look at the following and try to troubleshoot. Unfortunately this is a 3rd party application and Cornucopias cannot control the situation... but we can try to help. 

IMPORTANT: SweepWidget.com is NOT hosting the contest and we cannot help you with it.

Common error messages:

– Our anti-spam system has detected unusual activity.

– If you’re using a VPN or proxy service, please try disabling it.

– This entry has been flagged by our anti-spam system.

How do I fix this problem?

– If you are using a VPN, disable it.

– Try entering with a different email address. Use a common email address like Gmail, Hotmail, Outlook, Yahoo, or other major providers. Email addresses from custom domain or odd service providers can cause issues. Also, certain .ru email domains can cause issues.

@OG | Old Guard @Cornucopians 

Hello all! I just wanted to take moment and talk about security. Recently, there have been a ton of hacks on discord servers for a variety of NFT projects. Essentially, hackers are taking over discords by kicking the owners/mods and spreading false information and fake minting links. Unfortunately people are falling for it and losing hard earned money. 

We have taken the extra step to ensure that all of our platforms are 2FA protected via Google Authenticator. We take this VERY seriously. I encourage all of you to double check that your accounts are 2FA protected. Wallets, exchanges, social media, etc. The crypto space is a rewarding, yet dangerous place, so it's best to be prepared for all situations. 

Please go check your accounts and put another layer of security on for yourself and your hard earned cash! 

Stay safe everyone!!!
